name: Nagysimonyi (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagysimonyi: a blue shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a lion crest and red, yellow and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed Nagysimonyi.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagysimonyi arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
